name: Eye For Magic
body:
Prerequisite: Appraise 1 rank.

Benefit: You may use Appraise to determine the properties of a magical item, as if using the Spellcraft skill in conjunction with a detect magic spell. The DC for this check is 20 + the item’s caster level, or 15 + the item’s caster level if used in conjunction with a detect magic spell.
